The '''Barasin Crossing''' was the name of a bridge that spanned the [[Barasin Refuse Yards]], connecting the western edge of the [[Gorinth Canyon]] with [[Lower Sundari Outpost]] and the southern [[Sundari Flatlands]].<ref name="TOR" />
